anUnknownBenefactor.title: Interlude I: An Unknown Benefactor
anUnknownBenefactor.body:
Blessedly, the morning has come. Tiredness weighs you down like lead, and you want nothing more than to sink into your bed, but your bed perished in flames and sleep is a distant dream. Not to mention that with armed thugs still potentially after your head, you’re not sure you’d sleep a wink.

You decide to settle for a hot breakfast and a pot of strong coffee at Velma’s. While you wait for your food, a confused-looking waitress approaches your table, depositing on it a brown paper package with an envelope taped to the top. “This is for you,” she adds unnecessarily.

The letter in the envelope is short and to the point:

They wish to see you dead. I do not. This may help.

God knows, you could use an ally, and certainly somebody out there seems to be aiding you from afar. But you hesitate—it could be a trap, and if someone does want to help you, why not show their face?

The investigators must decide (choose one):

  • *I don’t know what this is, and I don’t trust it.* Proceed to _Going It Alone_.
  • *We’re out of our depth, here. We need all the help we can get.* Proceed to _Leap of Faith_.
anUnknownBenefactor.goingItAlone:
_Going It Alone:_ You shovel toast and eggs into your mouth, studiously ignoring the package before you. On your way out, you toss it into the trash.

  • In your Campaign Log, record that *the investigators declined an offer of help*.
  • Remove each {cultist} token from the chaos bag. Add 1 {tablet} token to the chaos bag.
anUnknownBenefactor.leapOfFaith:
_Leap of Faith:_ If someone wants to help prevent your untimely death, you have no objections. You carefully unwrap the package before you…

  • In your Campaign Log, mark 1 _Strange Assistance_ and record that *the investigators accepted an offer of help*.
  • Remove each {tablet} token from the chaos bag. Add 1 {cultist} token to the chaos bag.
